items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I don't know his first name, but I know it's Cesar. He's a pretty good arranger.

ctx.x: Thornton or Thompson or something like that.

I don't know his first name, but I know it's Cesar. He's a pretty good arranger. You never arranged anything yourself, huh? One number. And that was when I was with Willie O'Connor. He recorded. He was playing with Joe Robichard at the time. I found a new baby. Who? He was playing with Joe Robichard at the time. What was the number? I found a new baby. No. I mean, Joe Robichard records. He was playing with Joe Robichard's record. I don't think I've ever heard Joe Robichard's record of that. Joe Robichard recorded…
